name: Drishya
tagline: The Stage is Yours — where every emotion finds its spotlight.
description: The Dramatics Club of IIT Bhilai. From stage plays to street theatre, mime to mono-acts, we turn raw emotion into performance.

about.title: What We Do
about.description: Drishya is where stories come alive. We rehearse, we perform, we compete — and somewhere along the way, we discover parts of ourselves we didn't know existed.

highlights.title: Stage Plays
highlights.description: Full-length productions rehearsed over weeks — from classic adaptations to original scripts written by our members.

highlights.title: Street Theatre
highlights.description: Nukkad Natak that takes the stage to the people — raw, unfiltered, and impossible to ignore.

highlights.title: Mime & Mono-act
highlights.description: When words aren't enough, the body speaks. Our mime and solo acts have represented IIT Bhilai at Inter-IIT.

gallery.title: Behind the Curtain
gallery.description: Performances, rehearsals, and everything in between — the moments that make Drishya.

events.title: Cultscape
events.description: The grand cultural showdown — Drishya brought the house down with a murder mystery performance.

events.title: Inter-IIT Cultural Meet
events.description: Represented IIT Bhilai in Mime (8th) and Online Short Film (4th) at the national stage.

events.title: Nukkad Natak Drive
events.description: A street theatre campaign on campus addressing social awareness — performed across hostels.

events.title: Murder Mystery Night
events.description: An immersive whodunit where the audience was part of the investigation. Sold out in hours.

team.name: Mahesh
team.quote: Theatre taught me that vulnerability on stage is the greatest strength.

team.name: Core Member
team.quote: Every rehearsal is a new discovery — the script is just the starting point.

team.name: Core Member
team.quote: When you can't use words, you realise how much the body already knows.

team.name: Core Member
team.quote: The best scripts come from 2 AM conversations in the hostel common room.

join.title: Step On Stage
join.description: No experience needed. No auditions. If you've ever felt something and wanted to express it — you're already one of us.
